categories.title: Camp
categories.info: Visit camps to save your game, play music purchase items, unlock skills, and restore Tumbler charges. Some camps also allow you to fast travel and upgrade gear.

categories.title: Drone Upgrade Module
categories.info: Drone Upgrade Modules are used to unlock new drone upgrades at a repair console.

categories.title: Gear
categories.info: Gear effects are unlocked by finding other instances of that gear.

categories.title: Weapon Core
categories.info: Weapon Cores are used to enhance your attack power.

locations.title: Ledges
locations.description:
At the very edge of the building's outer rim.

From the island with the [Drone Upgrade Module](#loc=466100), you'll need to sprint towards the edge, double jump, dash in the air, and press the 'fast swim' button while briefly in the water to reach the building.

locations.title: Planet Diving Suit (6th)
locations.description:

- Polymer Material x75
